up: Show the exact activity values (i.e., where the standard relation is '=') for all compounds that were tested in the assay with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL3436042. For each matching activity record, provide the canonical SMILES of the compound, the compound's ChEMBL ID, the standard type, the standard relation, the standard value, and the standard units. Only include rows where the standard value is not null. Do not apply any limit to the number of rows returned.
sql: SELECT cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3436042' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL;
